summary.text: Matt Drew is a Republican state representative from Hillsborough 19 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Drew won the general election for New Hampshire House of Representatives Hillsborough 19 on November 5, 2024.
Ballotpedia lists the other candidates in the November 3, 2026 general election for the district's two seats as Jane Beaulieu (D), Chrissy Simonds (D) and Mickey Mullin (R).
